Classify features by reference-relative evaluation status

Source: R/CAMERA_evaluation_functions.R
classify_ref_status.Rd

Evaluation status is defined relative to the compound-centric reference feature set, not relative to an assumed ground truth. For each compound, the Tier 1a [M+H]+ feature is the anchor and defines the compound's expected group.

Ref-confirmed

Feature is assigned to the same group as its compound's anchor.

Ref-conflicting

Feature is assigned to a different group than its compound's anchor.

Ref-unmatched, co-grouped

Feature has no reference entry but shares a group with a compound's anchor (possible over-grouping).

Ref-unmatched, unrelated

Feature has no reference entry, and its group contains no compound anchor.

Ref-unassigned

Feature has a reference entry, but the tool assigned it no group. Zero for CAMERA, which groups every feature.

Rows that fit none of these statuses (e.g. a reference feature whose compound has no resolvable anchor) get NA and trigger a warning.

Usage

classify_ref_status(eval_full, anchors = NULL)

Arguments

eval_full

data.frame. Must contain Lib_group, pcgroup, CAMERA_grouped, CAMERA_split; ideally anchor_pcgroup.

anchors

Optional data.frame (output of build_anchors). Used to define the set of anchor groups for splitting Ref-unmatched. If NULL, eval_full$anchor_pcgroup is used.

Value

eval_full with an ordered factor column ref_status.
